text: Iere. 2.21. mat. 21.33. mark.12.1. luke 20.9. , Heb. the horne of the sonne of oyle.
Or, made a wall about it. , Heb. hewed.
Heb. plant of his pleasures. , Heb.a scab.
Or, this is in mine eares saith the LORD, &c. , Heb. If not, &c.
Heb. their glory are men of famine.
Or, the holy God. Heb. The God the holy.
Heb. that say concerning euill, It is good,&c.
Prou.3.7. rom. 12.16 , Heb. before their face.
Or, distresse. , Or, when it is light it shalbe darke in the destructions thereof.
